principles: MLSZ foundation, FIFA membership, professionalisation and post-war restart define structural chronology but are not direct annual quality measurements.
FIFA Big Count 2006 is gated to 2006+ for participation/access context.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 is gated to 2023+ for professional-ecosystem context.
Historic national-team results are not calibration targets; the model preserves strong tradition without using rankings or trophies.
9+ remains reserved for clearly world-leading dimensions; this pre-alpha curve tops out below 9.0.
